gloss: to pull in, to draw into

definitions.gloss: to pull in, to draw into
definitions.explanation: To bring or draw something or someone into a space or situation.
To get someone involved in a situation, often unwillingly.

examples.japanese: {客|きゃく}を{店|みせ}に{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To draw customers into the store.

examples.japanese: {物語|ものがたり}の{世界|せかい}に{引|ひ}き{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: I was drawn into the world of the story.

examples.japanese: {トラブル|とらぶる}に{引|ひ}き{込|こ}まれた。

notes:
{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む is a compound verb meaning to pull/draw into. Transitive godan verb.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
{引|ひ}く (to pull) + {込|こ}む (into). The 〜{込|こ}む suffix adds the nuance of entering or going deeply into.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {客|きゃく}を{店|みせ}に{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む: to draw customers into a store
- {話|はなし}に{引|ひ}き{込|こ}まれる: to be drawn into a story
- トラブルに{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む: to drag into trouble

TRANSITIVITY:
- {引|ひ}き{込|こ}む ({他動詞|たどうし}): to pull in
- {引|ひ}きこもる ({自動詞|じどうし}): to shut oneself in, withdraw

RELATED:
{引|ひ}きこもり refers to social withdrawal or a person who stays isolated at home.
